remainingStageFacts: A future source stage still needs the unchanged complete original/effective source-name peer inventory and independent complete prior-picker scan against its actual current inputs. This proposal does not replace those existing guards.

rules: Accept exactly one optional administrativeSuccession object in the existing town-preservation extension; require integer schemaVersion 1 and the exact method string.
Reject combination with retainedTownPoint, official-boundary replacements, sourcePhaseLineage, typedNamePeerExtension, deferredCompleteGroupExtension or top-level officialDelegationCode.

Initially support one different four-digit predecessor and one successor delegation code in the same governorate. officialDelegationCodes must equal [currentDelegationCode]. Do not expand to arbitrary multi-successor transfers.

requiredValidatorContract.step: Exact unchanged source and actual contexts
rules: Keep the common nine-state original/effective equality checks, actual source lookups, geometry hashes, provider transition None to osm, kind checks and exact curation bindings.
Require original and effective tags/kind/geometry identical for every successor sector and both actual contexts; administrative_context must not be represented as a source tag or geometry rewrite.
The contexts must contain exactly the real governorate plus the historicalDelegationContextId, whose actual source code is sourceDelegationCode. It remains labelled Smar 5353 in both phases.

Recompute all source delegation IDs with currentDelegationCode in each complete source phase; require both exact lists to equal the explicit empty lists. Do not create a synthetic ID, parent object, union geometry or containment fact for 5358.

Require one unique sectorSuccessions entry for every preserved sector, and no others; source-code and current-code sets are bijective, different, and share the declared predecessor/successor prefixes.
Each originalSectorCode must equal untouched original and effective source tags and uniquely identify its actual sector object among that complete source phase.

Each currentSectorCode and full officialIdentity must equal the exact selected registry row. The entries must cover every registry sector for currentDelegationCode, preserving the existing five-row complete-registry check.

Require the exact Arabic sector name in the untouched source to equal the registry sectorAr; reject unmatched names rather than normalize or infer a bridge. French source names and all source tags remain unchanged.

Require expectedAdministrativeCuration to equal both the live operative curation and common curationBindings for its source ID. Require action administrative_context, expectedKind sector, reviewedParentNames exactly, and expectedTags matching the source, including the exact old code and Arabic name.

For this bounded branch reject delegationId, governorateId, nameTags, manualPointId and picker changes on those five curation bindings; each existing record is a parent-name-only membership correction.

Bind reviewedParentNames exactly to all five active decisions; validate normalized current Arabic identity against registry and base, and normalized French current name against registry. Normalization is a predicate only; preserve all recorded spellings.

Load evidence through aggregate_review_file, verify URL/UTF-8 requiredText and explicitly pinned original-PDF-derived-text provenance; require the independent source review. This is reviewed identity succession, not a falsely labelled government relation-ID crosswalk.

requiredValidatorContract.step: Geographic context without a successor polygon
rules: Keep the existing coordinateContextMembership exact contains/covers checks for all five real sector shapes and the two real context shapes in both phases.
Keep positive governorate and historical-delegation containment for point and base, explicitly treating the latter as historical source context only.

Recompute coordinateReviewedSectorIds for point, base and every explicitly preserved independent point against all real sector source shapes in each phase. Require exactly one covering sector per coordinate; its ID must be one of the reviewed transferred sectors, with the validated active administrative_context rule.

For this snapshot point and base must both resolve to 7143819, and the independent hamlet to 7143821. These are source-sector containment facts plus reviewed administrative membership, not current delegation-border certification.

requiredValidatorContract.step: Independent inhabited point and full group preservation
rules: Require independentPointIds sorted and unique, disjoint from the candidate, sectors and contexts, and exactly equal to all protected non-polygon IDs except the candidate.

Initially restrict these independent points to unchanged hamlet nodes with no active direct curation, no base ownership and complete singleton self groups. This preserves Bir Morra rather than merging or omitting it.

Require full protected raw metadata and geometry as before. Permit expectedBeforeGroups keys to equal sector IDs plus candidate plus the explicit independentPointIds, retaining all existing group-membership validations.
Require expectedAfterGroups to differ only by replacing the candidate singleton key with delegation:1524; all independent and sector groups must remain byte/semantically exact.
Retain pair-form top-level completePickerGroups and all common final verification, nearest-reference, raw-ID, packed-geometry, source-name-peer and active prior-picker guards.

requiredValidatorContract.step: Complete baseline/generated raw-context and source-only preservation
rules: Load the byte-pinned entire baseline metadata. Independently derive raw IDs using governorateId351 AND (parentName equals the reviewed administrative marker OR contextAliases contains that exact marker); require the exact seven protected records and complete set.
Repeat this predicate over every generated raw feature in final verification; preserve all exact per-record/group/geometry checks.

Keep sourceOnlyAbsorbedPoints outside ordinary nine sourceStates. Validate exact original/effective source tags, kind, point geometry hash, null actual curation, absence from the pinned baseline, and the one same-name containing receiver in both complete source phases.
Independently derive every source point covered by the five retained source sectors; require exactly the candidate, independent hamlet and absorbed source-only point, without inventing a raw row.
Final verification requires the absorbed ID absent from all raw IDs, group keys/members and base ownership. Include that ID in the ordinary complete active prior-picker dependency scan.
